subject: carrot
name: 胡萝卜
label: 斜放的长胡萝卜
learning: 先观察主体各部分怎样连接，再挑几处有特点的细节。
prompt: One single carrot, medium-complexity original children's picture-book contour drawing. Square pure WHITE canvas. Graceful tapered carrot root with FOUR short curved root marks and one tiny side root. Crown has exactly THREE broad slightly feathery leaves, each leaf expressed with three large rounded lobes and one central vein, no small leaflets. Entire carrot diagonal and centered, 12 percent clear margin all around. Confident smooth BLACK outlines, all interiors empty white. No gray fill, no shading, no texture, no hatch marks, no labels, no other vegetables, no hands or people. Elegant natural proportions, connected stems. Simplify carefully while keeping a recognizable carrot.
